# StudyBuddy

> AI-powered study companion for engineering and exam-prep students. Includes AI doubt solver, mock tests, study planner, flashcards, formula sheets, attendance/CGPA tracking, and previous year papers (SPPU 2024 pattern).

## Pages

- [Dashboard](/): Personalized study dashboard with progress, streaks and reminders.
- [Subjects](/subjects): Track subjects, units and topics with spaced repetition.
- [Timetable](/timetable): Drag-and-drop weekly class schedule.
- [Study Timer](/study-timer): Background-accurate study timer.
- [Exam Dates](/exam-dates): Upcoming exam countdowns and alerts.
- [Previous Year Papers](/previous-year-papers): SPPU PYQs 2020–2024 as timed mocks.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free, Pro and Elite plans with a 7-day free trial.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How StudyBuddy handles user data.
- [Terms & Conditions](/terms): Terms of service.

## AI Tools

- [AI Doubt Solver](/ai-solver): Step-by-step explanations for academic doubts.
- [AI Study Plan](/study-plan): Personalized study schedule generator with PDF export.
- [AI Mock Test](/mock-test): Timed MCQ and theory mock tests with auto-grading.
- [AI Answer Checker](/answer-checker): SPPU 2024-pattern grading with feedback.
- [AI Formula Sheet](/formula-sheet): Unit-wise formula generator.
- [AI Exam Predictor](/exam-predictor): Predicts likely exam questions.
- [Performance Analysis](/performance): CGPA trends and gap analysis.

## Productivity

- [Flashcards](/flashcards): Build and review flashcards with spaced repetition.
- [Formula Bank](/formula-bank): Curated formulas for engineering subjects.
- [Attendance Tracker](/attendance): Stay above the 75% mark.
- [Marks & CGPA](/marks): Log marks and predict targets.
- [Assignments & Labs](/assignments): Deadline tracking.
- [Focus Mode](/focus): Distraction-free 25–90 minute timers.

## Community

- [Study Groups](/study-groups): Live group study rooms.
- [Doubt Forum](/doubt-forum): Q&A with classmates.
- [Study Buddy](/study-buddy): Match with peers by subjects.
- [Batch Feed](/batch-feed): Updates from your batch.
- [Share Progress](/share-progress): Branded progress cards.

## Optional

- [Sign In](/auth): Log in or create an account.
- [Notifications](/notifications): Reminder settings.
- [Profile](/profile): Account and subscription.
